Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper for a Paxos consensus specification. It extends an existing Paxos module, adds helper definitions and invariants about votes, chosen values, message validity, acceptor validity, and consistency, and then instantiates a separate consensus specification by mapping its chosen set to the values chosen by Paxos. The file focuses on safety properties rather than action-level behavior in this module itself: it defines state predicates and invariants over messages and acceptor state, and connects the Paxos model to a single-value consensus abstraction.
